text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report responds to an application submitted by the property owner of 25 Franson Crescent requesting approval for a site-specific Fence Exemption under Section 447-1.2B (1) and Section 447-1.2C (1) of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447 – Fences. The purpose of this report is to advise Community Council regarding the application submitted by the property owner of 25 Franson Crescent seeking approval for an existing wood fence that exceeds the maximum permitted height requirements. Municipal Licensing and Standards staff conducted a site inspection and obtained measurements of the existing fence panels from roadway inward. The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Granted a fence exemption permit to the property owner of 25 Franson Crescent and that at such time as replacement of the fence is required, the installation comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, Fences, or its successor by-law.
